reza-rassool.text: Campaign white paper: says COC suffers from "Fiscal Scandal and Negative Climate Survey" and that "only radical fiscal transparency and shared governance can restore the college's reputation as a responsible steward of public tax dollars."

source.title: Reza Rassool campaign white paper: Student Empowerment

reza-rassool.text: Calls some campus buildings "vanity construction projects built for a different era"; proposes an industrial residency program where businesses set up on campus for reduced rent in exchange for internships, apprenticeships and job offers for vocational and technical students.

source.title: Reza Rassool campaign white paper: Student Empowerment

reza-rassool.text: Argues AI should be treated as "a tool-of-the-trade that our students must master," not mainly a cheating tool; says colleges must adjust pedagogical goals for automation.

source.title: Reza Rassool campaign white paper: Student Empowerment

reza-rassool.text: Campaign site: running to keep College of the Canyons "affordable, high-quality, and student-centered—supporting transfer, certificates, and workforce training for all students."
Endorsed by the California Teachers Association, the COC Faculty Association, COC classified employees, and the AFL-CIO.
Endorsed by the LA County Democratic Party, California Democrats, SCV Democrats, Rep. George Whitesides, and Stonewall.

darlene-trevino.text: Campaign site says she "pushed to strengthen financial oversight by demanding a forensic audit and review of all contracts and expenditures" and believes in "setting and sustaining a balanced budget with regular status updates."

source.title: Ballotpedia: Darlene Trevino (quoting campaign website, Sept. 24, 2026)

darlene-trevino.text: Says she championed the district's Student Equity and Achievement Plan to improve access, completion and career outcomes, "especially for student groups experiencing achievement gaps," including counseling, tutoring and early-alert programs.

source.title: Ballotpedia: Darlene Trevino (quoting campaign website, Sept. 24, 2026)

darlene-trevino.text: Has proposed "responsible Artificial Intelligence (AI) policies centered on ethics, privacy, and equity" and prioritizes facility modernization to reduce deferred maintenance costs.

source.title: Ballotpedia: Darlene Trevino (quoting campaign website, Sept. 24, 2026)

darlene-trevino.text: Wants to expand workforce programs such as the Employee Training Institute for local businesses and apprenticeships that "combine classroom instruction with paid on-the-job training."

source.title: Ballotpedia: Darlene Trevino (quoting campaign website, Sept. 24, 2026)

darlene-trevino.text: In Sept. 2025 voted with trustees Arnold and Johnson (3-1-1) to place Interim CEO David Andrus on paid leave pending termination, despite faculty and staff resolutions supporting him.

source.title: KHTS: College Of The Canyons Board Votes To Remove Interim CEO David Andrus (Sept. 2025)
